Question: What is the loss ratio, number of claims, total loss by policy number and premium where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount and loss ratio is total loss divided by premium?
Generated Query:
WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ccd.Policy_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS total_loss
    FROM Claim_Amount ca
    INNER JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
    INNER JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail ccd
        ON ccd.Effective_Date = cc.Effective_Date
       AND ccd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Payment lp WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Loss_Reserve lr WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Payment ep WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Expense_Reserve er WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier)
    GROUP BY
        ccd.Policy_Identifier,
        ca.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT
        Policy_Identifier,
        COUNT(*) AS number_of_claims,
        SUM(total_loss) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_totals
    GROUP BY Policy_Identifier
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    INNER JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    COALESCE(pp.premium, 0) AS premium,
    COALESCE(pl.number_of_claims, 0) AS number_of_claims,
    COALESCE(pl.total_loss, 0) AS total_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(pp.premium, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COALESCE(pl.total_loss, 0) / pp.premium
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM Policy p
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp
    ON pp.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_loss pl
    ON pl.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
WHERE COALESCE(pp.premium, 0) <> 0
   OR COALESCE(pl.total_loss, 0) <> 0
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number;

JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr

What is the total loss of each claim by claim number where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
   OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Company_Claim_Number;
